lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: High-luminance circular spots are arranged in vertical columns posterior to the gills. The nodes are more densely packed in the anterior region and become more sparse and larger toward the posterior flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Pale vertical stripes intersect with horizontal rows of high-intensity spots, creating a defined grid-like structure across the mid-lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three distinct longitudinal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a light-to-shadow gradient running dorsally to ventrally.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Low-contrast, diffuse high-luminance spots are visible within the silhouette of the first dorsal fin, mainly concentrated in the mid-region of the fin.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Irregular serrations and a prominent notch are visible along the trailing edge of the first dorsal fin. A darker, irregular patch is present posterior to the branchial region.
other_distinctive_markers: The dorsal surface of the pectoral fin displays a dense constellation of small, high-luminance spots that are notably smaller and more uniform than those on the primary lateral flank.
